name: Portainer
description: Manage Docker containers visually.
use: Open Portainer for advanced container settings, logs and maintenance.

name: Uptime Kuma
description: Monitor whether devices and websites are online.
use: Add the addresses you rely on and choose how often Uptime Kuma should check them.

name: Jellyfin
description: Stream your own movies, television and music.
use: Add media to /opt/ayvatech-home-server/data/jellyfin/media, then create libraries in Jellyfin.

name: File Browser
description: Manage server files from a web browser.
use: Use this for quick uploads, folders and downloads on your home network.

name: Home Assistant
description: Control and automate compatible smart-home devices.
use: Create your owner account, then add devices from Settings → Devices & services.

name: AYVAtech Dashboard
description: Your home-server control centre.
use: Start here whenever you want to open an app or check server health.

name: Windows File Share
description: Open shared server folders from Windows Explorer.
use: In Windows Explorer, enter \\\\homeserver to see available shared folders.

name: Immich
description: Back up and organise phone photos locally.
use: Install the Immich mobile app and point it to this server address.

name: Nextcloud
description: Run a private cloud for files, calendars and contacts.
use: Create the administrator account, then install desktop or mobile sync clients.

name: Paperless-ngx
description: Turn scanned paperwork into a searchable archive.
use: Upload PDFs or place documents in its consume folder for automatic processing.

name: AdGuard Home
description: Block advertising and trackers across the home network.
use: Complete its setup wizard, then configure your router to use this server for DNS.

name: Vaultwarden
description: Host a Bitwarden-compatible family password vault.
use: Configure secure remote access and backups before relying on it for passwords.

name: Syncthing
description: Keep selected folders synchronised between computers.
use: Pair trusted devices, then choose exactly which folders each device may access.

description: Monitor CPU, memory, disks, temperatures and containers over time.
name: Beszel
use: Open Beszel to review hardware history, container usage and server alerts.

description: Create scheduled, encrypted backups of important server data.
name: Duplicati
use: Choose the folders to protect, a separate backup destination and a schedule.

description: Stream your personal music collection to browsers and mobile apps.
name: Navidrome
use: Point Navidrome at your music folder, scan the library and connect a compatible player.

description: Organise audiobooks and podcasts while keeping listening progress.
name: Audiobookshelf
use: Create libraries for audiobooks and podcasts, then connect the mobile application.

description: Reach your server remotely through a private encrypted network.
name: Tailscale
use: Sign in, approve the server and use its private Tailscale address while away from home.

description: Follow news sites and blogs without an algorithmic timeline.
name: FreshRSS
use: Add RSS feeds or import an OPML subscription file from another reader.

description: Manage a private envelope-style household budget.
name: Actual Budget
use: Create a budget file, add accounts and allocate income to spending categories.

description: Save recipes, plan meals and build shopping lists.
name: Mealie
use: Create a household, import recipes and use the weekly meal planner.

description: Host a private Minecraft world for friends and family.
name: Minecraft Server
use: Choose the game version, memory allowance, world settings and approved players.

name: Living Room Mode
description: Use this computer under a television with Jellyfin TV mode and VLC DVD playback.
use: Open AYVAtech Living Room Mode Setup from the application menu. Connect Jellyfin Desktop to http://homeserver.local:8096 and use VLC for physical DVDs.
